Chess Club proposes 'Echo Hackathon 2027', a Hackathon planned for 2027-03-04 at the Seminar
Hall.

We expect approximately 94 attendees for this Hackathon, in line with turnout at our previous
Hackathon events.

The requested budget of INR 37,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Hackathon.

Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.

This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
